meta.name: partners
meta.description: 231 (plan stage B, B1; DECISIONS 231): the roles an outside party may play in the shared partner register (jav/app/partners.py). One partner may play several roles; a process names the role its partners play. The labels are English; the interface translates them.

changelog.note: 231 (B1): the first roles: customer, supplier, insured, broker.

customer.label: Customer
customer.what: Asks for a quote or buys: a quote's requester, an outgoing invoice's buyer.

supplier.label: Supplier
supplier.what: Sells to the own party: an incoming invoice's supplier.

insured.label: Insured
insured.what: A person or company an insurance quote is made for.

broker.label: Broker
broker.what: Brings an insurance case on behalf of the insured.
